change: Standard selection haptics for Vim and joystick
behavior: Vim wheel uses platform SegmentTick instead of SegmentFrequentTick. Joystick emits SegmentTick only when a new non-neutral direction is entered. Neutral pauses, repeated arrows and jitter within the same direction emit no extra haptics. Existing Vim preference and system touch-feedback settings remain respected. No direct vibrator calls, extra permissions or phone-setting changes. The shutter backing ring remains removed from release 50.
test_notes: Five focused Android checks passed with a recording haptic provider, including arrow repeats, neutral pauses, valid-direction changes and the Vim toggle. No physical haptic-strength measurement was made.
source_commit: Uncommitted source changes based on signed commit 19f60a163e
phone_install: Installed release 51 on S22+ RFCT21390SD via USB; checksum matches; app data preserved; app not launched.
